name: Lez Ane ni Otoko o Oshiete Yarimashita ~Kanojo wa Ane ni Netorareteimashita~
original_name: レズ姉に男を教えてやりました ～彼女は姉に寝取られていました～
source:
Today was my date with my girlfriend Tsukasa Yara, but she called me yesterday to say no and we had no plans to go out. I was wandering around the date course to look around anyway, when I saw her, next to her was my sister Saeko, who I don't get along with well! 

"Why are they together, when she didn't want to go on a date with me?" 

Seeing them together, I couldn't help but lose my temper. I found myself following them. Then they walked into a love hotel holding hands without my knowledge. 

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_260/apt_260.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
translation:
今天是我和女友矢良司的约会，但她昨天打电话给我拒绝了，我们没有出去的计划。反正我是在约会场闲逛，四处看看，看到她的时候，她旁边是我和我关系不太好的妹妹纱荣子！

“当她不想和我约会时，他们为什么在一起？” 

看到他们在一起，我忍不住发脾气。我发现自己跟着他们。然后他们在我不知情的情况下牵着手走进了一家情人旅馆。

[来自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_260/apt_260.html#link_story]官方网站[/url]]
